Name: Celestial_Edict_of_Silence
Description: Every 90 seconds, a divine silence sweeps the dungeon for 15 seconds, preventing all skill usage. Only basic attacks function during this period.

Name: Celestial_Forced_Tithes
Description: At the end of each floor, players must pay a tithe (e.g., currency, consumables, health) to progress. Refusing or offering too little summons a horde of angels that attack with relentless zeal.

Name: Celestial_Eternal_Chorus
Description: Certain areas resonate with a haunting celestial hymn. While within earshot of the chorus, all cooldowns are increased, and resource regeneration is halved. Players must destroy the source of the hymn to silence it.

Name: Celestial_Angelic_Wardens
Description: Massive angelic statues are scattered throughout the dungeon. When players trigger certain traps or violate "divine laws," these statues animate and relentlessly hunt them for the rest of the floor.

Name: Celestial_Divine_Resurgence
Description: Once per floor, all defeated enemies on that floor resurrect at half health in a sudden holy revival.

Name: Celestial_Divine_Wrath
Description: Players are periodically targeted by massive beams of radiant light that chase them across the floor. These beams destroy enemies in their path but deal devastating damage to players if they fail to avoid them.

Name: Celestial_Golden_Spires
Description: Floors feature radiant towers that heal enemies and buff their damage. These spires must be destroyed to progress effectively.

Name: Celestial_Hallowed_Groundfall
Description: Angelic artillery bombards random areas every 30 seconds, leaving consecrated craters that burn players and empower enemies.

Name: Celestial_Heaven_s_Quake
Description: Radiant pillars crash through the ceiling, creating impassable terrain and forcing reroutes mid-combat.

Name: Celestial_Holy_Repercussions
Description: Enemies have a chance to retaliate with radiant bursts upon being hit, dealing damage in an area and inflicting "Judgment" (a stacking debuff that increases holy damage taken).

Name: Celestial_Lightforged_Walls
Description: Radiant barriers seal sections until all enemies in the area are slain, forcing full clears.

Name: Celestial_Trial_of_Endurance
Description: A divine timer per floor; if it expires before the floor is cleared, all enemies gain doubled damage and resistances.

Name: Celestial_Judgment_Zones
Description: Radiant zones spawn for 20 seconds; standing inside ramps holy damage to players but increases boss loot quality if triggered 5+ times.

Name: Celestial_Sanctioned_Passage
Description: Divine gates require a 10s channel to open; enemies surge toward the gate during the unlock.

Name: Celestial_Wings_of_the_Host
Description: Angelic flyovers carpet-bomb the map with radiant feathers that pierce terrain and deal % max HP damage.

Name: Chaos_Fragmented_Reality
Description: Certain sections of the dungeon are "Fragmented." When you enter one, your stats are randomly scrambled. For example, your power might be increased but your defenses are halved, or your health is doubled but you can no longer use skills.

Name: Chaos_Unstable_Portal
Description: The only way to get to the next floor is through a series of unstable portals. Stepping through a portal has a 50% chance of taking you to the next floor, a 25% chance of returning you to the beginning of the current floor, and a 25% chance of spawning a powerful, unpredictable mini-boss.

Name: Chaos_Reality_Twister
Description: Every 30 seconds, a random modifier is added to the entire dungeon. The modifier can be anything from increased enemy damage to reduced player movement speed, or even a beneficial one like increased magic find. The modifiers are permanent for the duration of the dungeon.

Name: Chaos_Rule_of_Chaos
Description: The normal rules of the game are suspended within these dungeons. Gameplay mechanics and systems become randomized or altered, challenging players to adapt on the fly. This could involve changes to character attributes, skill behavior, or even unconventional victory conditions.

Name: Chaos_Chaos_Touched
Description: Every floor, a random buff or debuff is added to the player. These do not have the normal time limits and will continue to stack unless cleansed.

Name: Chaos_Chaotic_Loot
Description: Items dropped by enemies have randomized stats within a wide range, making each piece potentially extremely valuable or useless.

Name: Chaos_Pandora_s_Box
Description: Random chests appear throughout the dungeon. Opening them can either grant powerful rewards or unleash waves of chaos-spawned enemies, forcing players to gamble on their luck.

Name: Chaos_Trick_or_Treat
Description: Picking up loot spawns additional enemies or applies temporary buffs to the player.

Name: Chaos_Unstable_Dimensions
Description: Every time you clear a floor, the very fabric of the dungeon warps. A new "reality" is imposed, granting a new, random modifier to all enemies on the next floor. This could range from "All enemies are immune to fire damage" to "All enemies drop 100% more gold." The randomness will force players to be agile and adapt on the fly.

Name: Chaos_Volatile_Evolution
Description: Enemies have a chance to mutate into higher rarity mobs once they drop below 75% hp.

Name: Chaos_Wild_Magic
Description: Casting a skill has a 5% chance to trigger the effect of a random different skill from your class tree.

Name: Chaos_The_Labrynth
Description: Dungeon rooms rearrange themselves periodically. Players might find paths they already cleared are now blocked or redirected.

Name: Chaos_Echo_Chamber
Description: Every time you use an ability, a ghostly copy of that ability is fired in a random direction. The copy can hit enemies, but it can also hit you, dealing a small amount of damage. This creates a new layer of risk/reward to using skills.

Name: Chaos_Illusory_Enemies
Description: Some enemies are illusions. They look and act like real enemies but do no damage.

Name: Chaos_Reality_Rifts
Description: The fabric of reality is unstable in Chaos Lord dungeons, leading to the creation of temporary portals or rifts. Players can use these rifts strategically to teleport, gain buffs, or access hidden areas.

Name: Death_The_Reaper
Description: The embodiment of death slowly stalks the player. If they are hit by his scythe, they instantly die.

Name: Death_Echoes_of_the_Past
Description: Spectral versions of enemies killed on the previous floor appear and repeat their final attacks before vanishing.

Name: Death_Mortal_Decay
Description: The Death cataclysm introduces an affliction of mortal decay, gradually sapping the player's life force as they progress through the dungeon. To counter this, the player must give death his due souls by reaping enemies to temporarily slow the effect of the affliction.

Name: Death_Cryptquake
Description: Sections of the floor collapse into pits of bones, forcing new routes and spawning skeletal swarms from below.

Name: Death_Dead_Rising
Description: Enemies have a chance to revive after being killed.

Name: Death_Death_s_Embrace
Description: Players periodically gain stacks of a debuff called "Embrace of Death," which reduces healing received. Stacks reset when entering a new floor.

Name: Death_Dirge_Resonance
Description: Distant funeral music plays; when it crescendos, all enemies gain haste and fear immunity for 10 seconds.

Name: Death_Funereal_Procession
Description: A slow-moving line of spectral pallbearers moves through the dungeon; contact causes heavy damage and fear.

Name: Death_Grave_Tide
Description: Waves of undead periodically rise from the ground and flood the dungeon. These waves grow stronger and more numerous the longer players remain on a floor.

Name: Death_Grim_Totems
Description: Throughout the dungeons, players encounter grim totems emanating dark energy. Interacting with these totems offers a choice between embracing their malevolent power or dispelling them to cleanse the area. Embracing the power of the totems grants temporary bonuses but may also trigger more difficult enemy spawns or curses. Cleansing the totems purifies the environment, removing harmful effects and weakening nearby enemies.

Name: Death_Necrotic_Bloom
Description: Cursed flowers sprout in random areas; if not destroyed, they spawn waves of undead every 20s.

Name: Death_Obsidian_Sarcophagi
Description: Indestructible coffins pulse with death magic, granting enemies in range bonus damage and resistance. Once enough nearby enemies have been slain, a Vampire Lord erupts from the coffin to kill the player.

Name: Death_Soul_Chains
Description: Certain sections of the dungeon are lined with ethereal chains that bind the souls of trapped adventurers. Players must release these souls by defeating specific enemies. Freeing the souls may grant rewards or open up new paths.

Name: Death_Vengful_Wraiths
Description: Enemies have a 10% chance of turning into wraiths when killed. Wraiths have 90% damage reduction, 20% increased damage, movespeed, and attack speed. In their death they are fueled by rage towards the one who killed them and will hunt them across the entire dungeon.

Name: Death_Necrotic_Ground
Description: The dungeon floor is covered in a spreading necrotic fog. The fog deals damage over time and reduces your healing effectiveness by 50% while standing in it. Enemies standing in the fog regen their health at 10%/s.

Name: Demonic_Infernal_Brand
Description: Hitting an enemy applies a stack of 'Brand' to you. At 20 stacks, you erupt in a fire nova that deals 20% of your max HP to you and nearby allies.

Name: Demonic_Blood_Bond
Description: You are soul-linked to the first elite you see on each floor. This enemy cannot die unless you do and is immune to your damage.

Name: Demonic_Infernal_Rain
Description: Fireballs rain in combat zones, leaving patches of burning ground that deal fire damage over time for 10 seconds.

Name: Demonic_Abyssal_Rifts
Description: Portals to the Abyss open up, unleashing waves of demonic creatures. Players must close these rifts by defeating waves of enemies within a given time limit. The difficulty and rewards increase with each successfully closed rift.

Name: Demonic_Blood_Altar
Description: Slaying enemies contributes to the blood altar. The altar sends out damaging pulses that grow stronger with the number of enemies slain.

Name: Demonic_Blood_Gates
Description: Doors leading to the next level in a dungeon are sealed shut until the player has slain enough enemies to open them

Name: Demonic_Blood_Price
Description: Interacting with chests, shrines, or levers costs a percentage of current HP. Gain a permanent, uncleansable stack of bleed each time.

Name: Demonic_Demonic_Guide
Description: Player's are chained to a demonic guide. Straying too far from their guide will cause the player to take increased damage.

Name: Demonic_Hellfire
Description: Enemies have a chance to explode in hellfire when killed.

Name: Demonic_Infernal_Beacons
Description: Each floor contains an Infernal Beacon. Enemies in the dungeon gain a stacking power score buff per beacon activated while the player gains a stacking magic find buff.

Name: Demonic_Infernal_Seals
Description: The door on each floor is locked by a particular seal. The seals are held by powerful enemies on each floor and the player must collect all 4 pieces of the seal in order to unlock the door to the next floor.

Name: Demonic_Pact_of_Temptation
Description: Players are offered pacts by the dungeon at the end of each floor. Accepting a pact grants a powerful buff for the floor but applies a curse for the rest of the dungeon.

Name: Demonic_Soul_Harvest
Description: Defeated enemies release demonic souls that empower other enemies nearby. Souls float toward the nearest demon, granting increased health, damage, and resistances.

Name: Demonic_Demon_Prince
Description: Occassionally when you slay an enemy, a demonic prince will rip out through it's corpse and attack you.

Name: Famine_Scarcity
Description: At the start of each floor, a random equipment slot (excluding weapons) has its stats and enchantments disabled for that floor.

Name: Famine_Desperate_Measures
Description: When your Mana falls below 10%, your skills cost 5% of your current Health to cast instead of Mana.

Name: Famine_Dehydration
Description: Each floor the player's maximum resource is reduced by 1%.

Name: Famine_Diminishing_Returns
Description: Potions lose effectiveness over time, forcing players to find new resources or adapt their playstyle.

Name: Famine_Famished_Beasts
Description: Enemies actively seek out and consume dropped items, denying players their rewards and getting stronger with each item eaten.

Name: Famine_Hard_Mode
Description: Players cannot use potions in this dungeon.

Name: Famine_Luxury_Hoarders
Description: Certain rooms contain elites or mini-bosses guarding piles of resources. Players must choose whether to expend resources fighting for potential rewards.

Name: Famine_Ravenous_Hoard
Description: Enemies in the dungeon grow stronger the longer they remain alive, as their desperation turns into aggression.

Name: Famine_Recession
Description: Potions take 4x as many kills to fill.

Name: Famine_Starvation
Description: Each floor the players's maximum hp and energy shield are reduced by 1%. Up to 60%.

Name: Famine_Starvation_Curse
Description: Each new floor adds a starvation debuff, such as slower movement or reduced max health. These debuffs persist unless cleansed.

Name: Famine_Suffering_Aura
Description: The dungeon passively saps the player’s resources (e.g., health, mana, stamina) at a slow but constant rate.

Name: Famine_Swarm_of_Locusts
Description: Periodically, swarms of locusts sweep through the dungeon, obscuring vision and dealing continuous damage. Players must find shelter or use specific abilities to survive the swarm.

Name: Famine_Withering_Touch
Description: Enemies have a chance to inflict a stacking debuff that reduces your max HP and max mana. This debuff is permanent for the duration of the dungeon and can only be removed by defeating a floor boss.

Name: Famine_Withered_Ground
Description: Enemies leave patches of Barren Earth on death. While standing on it, your Health and Mana recovery (regen/leech) is reduced by 80%.

Name: Pestilence_Plague_Convergence
Description: If players spend too long on a floor, the dungeon begins to "converge" on them. Hordes of enemies will spawn continuously, all carrying highly contagious diseases that stack exponentially with every hit. The only way to stop the convergence is to complete objectives quickly and descend to the next floor.

Name: Pestilence_The_Plaguebearer
Description: One random elite on each floor is a "Plaguebearer." This enemy doesn't directly attack you, but it constantly applies a stacking disease debuff to all other enemies in the dungeon. The Plaguebearer's debuff increases the damage of other enemies by 5% per stack, to a maximum of 10 stacks. The Plaguebearer will flee when you get close, forcing you to hunt it down to make the rest of the floor manageable.

Name: Pestilence_Fungal_Overgrowth
Description: Killing enemies creates mushrooms. Stepping on them grants either a 50% speed boost or a 50% slow.

Name: Pestilence_Carrion_Feast
Description: Rotting carcasses attract swarms of carrion feeders that consume the bodies, growing stronger and more numerous with each corpse. Players can prevent this by burning bodies with fire-based abilities or finding "purification altars" to consecrate the area.

Name: Pestilence_Contagious_Touch
Description: Enemies no longer deal damage on contact. Instead, they apply a stacking "Contagion" debuff. When you hit an enemy, you take a percentage of their total health as damage for every stack of the debuff. The only way to remove the debuff is to kill the enemy that applied it.

Name: Pestilence_Epidemic
Description: When you kill a diseased enemy, there is a 25% chance for the disease to spread to a nearby enemy, applying all of the dead enemy's remaining debuffs. If the disease spreads 5 times in a single chain, all nearby enemies are instantly killed, but a powerful "Plague Lord" will spawn to attack you.

Name: Pestilence_Infection_Bloom
Description: Certain areas of the dungeon are overtaken by massive, living "Infection Blooms," grotesque, pulsating masses of diseased flesh and tendrils. These blooms slowly spread across the environment, corrupting the terrain and empowering nearby enemies. If left unchecked, they release waves of plague-ridden creatures that swarm players. Destroying the bloom halts its spread and weakens affected enemies, but the destruction also triggers a final surge of toxic spores or pestilent minions as a last defense.

Name: Pestilence_Infested_Veins
Description: Living tunnels and walls pulsate with veins of infectious growths that create a toxic environment. Players can choose to destroy these veins to temporarily cleanse the area, but destroying too much summons toxic "guardians" from the infection.

Name: Pestilence_Leech_Spores
Description: When you kill an enemy, a cloud of Leech Spores explodes from their corpse. If you come into contact with the spores, a small portion of your health is drained and used to heal any enemies within a 10-meter radius. This forces the player to manage their positioning after every kill, a critical strategic element.

Name: Pestilence_Pestilent_Empowerment
Description: Players must find and destroy the plague beacons on each floor if they want to lower the power of enemies on later floors.

Name: Pestilence_Plague_Harbingers
Description: Certain enemies act as "Harbingers", spreading disease trails wherever they walk. These trails linger, damaging players who cross them and amplifying nearby enemy stats. Killing Harbingers cleanses the trails and weakens nearby enemies.

Name: Pestilence_Quarantine_Breach
Description: Groups of monsters containing highly infectious diseases have been frozen in time in order to prevent the diseases they carry from spreading. Players can choose to break the containment to fight these enemies for great rewards, but doing so risks spreading the infection further.

Name: Pestilence_Raw_Sewage
Description: The dungeon is an actual cesspool, filled with rivers of toxic waste that will spread disease stacks to the player. These disease stacks do not time out and must be cleansed.

Name: Pestilence_Spore_Clouds
Description: Enemies have a chance to release spores on death that poison the player.

Name: Pestilence_The_Infested_Hoard
Description: All enemies have a chance to drop infested gold and items. Picking up infested loot will apply a stack of "Infestation" that drains your health over time. However, the more stacks you have, the higher your chance of finding more infested loot. It's a risk/reward system where you must weigh the benefits of a huge haul against the dangerous health drain.

Name: Void_The_Blackest_Shadow
Description: The dungeon is pitch black. A single, small orb of light follows the player, but it is not enough to illuminate the entire dungeon. Enemies that are not in the light are completely invisible, and they gain a permanent "Invisible Stalker" buff that grants them 100% more damage and 50% faster attack speed.

Name: Void_Singularity_Wells
Description: Pulsing void orbs pull players and projectiles toward them, dealing void damage and slowing movement by 40%.

Name: Void_All_Consuming
Description: Enemies that the player kills aren't forgotten, instead a portion of their stats are fed back into the void to fuel the final boss of the dungeon.

Name: Void_Anti_Magic_Zones
Description: Certain areas in the Void dungeons nullify magical abilities, forcing players to rely on their physical skills and adapt to the environment.

Name: Void_Insanity_Bursts
Description: Prolonged exposure to the Void's influence triggers bursts of insanity, causing players to lose control over their abilities, attack allies, or experience debilitating effects. Players must regain composure or rely on teamwork to overcome these moments of chaos

Name: Void_Mind_Shattering_Illusions
Description: The Void manipulates perception, creating hallucinations and phantasmal enemies that can harm or disorient players. They must discern reality from illusion, navigate through treacherous encounters, and maintain their sanity.

Name: Void_Portal_Unleashing
Description: The dungeon is riddled with unstable portals that periodically spawn twisted abominations from the void. Players must swiftly dispatch these creatures before they overwhelm the party.

Name: Void_Shadowy_Enemies
Description: Void dungeons could be infested with shadowy enemies that can only be harmed when exposed to light. Players must use their abilities or environmental factors to illuminate and weaken these foes.

Name: Void_The_Nihil_s_Embrace
Description: The dungeon is filled with a constant, humming void energy. As you move, your resistances are slowly and permanently reduced. To cleanse the effect, you must defeat a high tier enemy. The boss's defeat will restore all of your resistances and grant a temporary buff.

Name: Void_Those_in_the_Dark
Description: The dungeon has chasms spread throughout leading to the abyss. If the player falls into them, they fall down into the void realm where dangerous enemeis lurk. The player will have to fight their way out in order to get back to the main dungeon and surviving will bring great rewards.

Name: Void_Void_Parasite
Description: Every enemy you kill has a chance to spawn a parasitic voidling. If the voidling reaches you, it will attach to you and siphon your power, reducing your damage, resistances, and movement speed. The voidling can be removed by standing in a "light" zone, but these are rare.

Name: Void_Grasping_Tentacles
Description: Void tentacles appear all over the dungeon. The player will have to be careful of getting too close or they might be grabbed, restricting their movement.

Name: War_Supply_Lines
Description: A supply cart must be escorted to the end of the dungeon. If the cart is destroyed, you lose.

Name: War_Royal_Guard
Description: When an above Uncommon ranked enemy drops below 30% health, there is a 50% chance they summon two guards of the next higher rank.

Name: War_Forced_March
Description: You take stacking damage if you stand still for >3s. It forces a "run and gun" playstyle.

Name: War_Battlefield_Relics
Description: Scattered throughout the dungeon are ancient relics of war that can be activated to give powerful but temporary buffs. However, activating a relic also summons the spirits of fallen warriors who will relentlessly pursue the players until they are defeated.

Name: War_Battlefield_Tactics
Description: War-themed dungeons feature strategic encounters where players must utilize tactical positioning and coordination. Enemies may employ formations, flanking maneuvers, or defensive barriers that require players to adapt their approach.

Name: War_Blood_Debt
Description: Players start the dungeon owing a "blood debt" to a war god. As they kill enemies, they reduce the debt, gaining blessings. However, if they fail to pay off the debt by the end, they are cursed with a powerful debuff during the boss fight.

Name: War_Blood_Forged_Champions
Description: Elite enemies absorb the strength of nearby dying allies, growing stronger and potentially transforming into a mini-boss.

Name: War_Commander_s_Aura
Description: Certain elite enemies act as commanders, providing buffs (e.g., increased health, damage, or resistance) to nearby allies.

Name: War_Field_Medic
Description: An elite "Medic" enemy is present on each floor. It does not attack, but constantly heals all other enemies in a large radius. This forces the player to prioritize a non-threatening enemy.

Name: War_March_of_Progress
Description: Each floor, enemies damage increases by 10%. Killing the Commander in each level will increase the player's armor by 10%. If the player skips killing too many commanders, they may find they can't withstand the increasing damage.

Name: War_Morale_Break
Description: Certain enemies panic and flee when their leader dies, but if allowed to escape, they return later with reinforcements.

Name: War_War_Banner
Description: Players can plant a "War Banner" that grants significant buffs in a radius but also attracts waves of enemies. The banner must be defended for a certain period to gain its full benefits.

Name: War_Artillery_Strike
Description: Every 30 seconds, a massive red circle appears on the ground. A powerful artillery strike will land in that circle, dealing massive damage to everything inside. Enemies and players can be hit, creating a strategic element of using the enemy's own weapons against them.

Name: War_Fog_of_War
Description: Vision is limited by a thick battlefield fog. Players can only see a short distance ahead, making ambushes frequent and navigating difficult.

Name: War_Warzone_Control_Points
Description: Dungeons in the War cataclysm feature control points that players must capture and hold against waves of enemies. Holding these points provides strategic advantages, such as summoning allied soldiers, gaining access to powerful buffs, or opening shortcuts to progress deeper into the dungeon.
